verdict.rationale: Google ADK is a framework for building agents, so a built-in assistant that takes delegated tasks inside it is a fair question. The evidence shows no such first-party assistant. The dev UI (gh-3) is for testing your own agents. The AI-assisted workflows (docs-9, docs-10) depend on connecting your own external coding assistant or AI-enabled environment. Both are adjacent or user-side, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
